stocks.summary_en: Author relays Elon Musk saying SpaceX compute rental prices are rising overall, especially for large high-bandwidth training clusters, contrasting with market selloff on oversupply fears.
Author says Musk's comments on SPCX compute rental prices are relevant to NBIS and other Neocloud compute-rental companies, without giving a specific NBIS view.
Author quotes a bearish view that labs will get better returns on components than NVDA and bid up prices until Nvidia cannot profitably secure components.
Author shares Leopold's forecast that ANT could run-rate many hundreds of billions in revenue by end-2027, plausibly approaching $1T on its own.

Author highlights Lumentum's take-or-pay customer commitments and prepayment elements, calling it a gold standard for financing and demand signals.
stocks.summary_ko: 작성자는 Lumentum의 테이크 오어 페이(take-or-pay) 고객 약정 및 선지급 요소를 강조하며 이를 자금 조달 및 수요 신호의 '골드 스탠다드'라고 부릅니다.

stocks.summary_en: Author notes Coherent's CEO cited upfront payments in almost every LTA and groups Coherent with Lumentum as a gold standard for financing and demand signals.

stocks.summary_en: Author cites Palo Alto Networks' November research documenting 25 operations against at least 19 organizations.
stocks.summary_ko: 작가는 팔로알토 네트웍스의 11월 연구를 인용하여 최소 19개 조직을 대상으로 한 25건의 공격을 기록하고 있습니다.

stocks.summary_en: Author cites Microsoft's October report of a large-scale nation-state campaign using ARTEX that enables supply chain compromise for downstream customers.
stocks.summary_ko: 작성자는 ARTEX를 사용하여 다운스트림 고객의 공급망을 침해하는 대규모 국가 주도 캠페인에 대한 Microsoft의 10월 보고서를 인용합니다.

stocks.summary_en: Author cites Google Threat Intelligence Group's November finding of a significant inflection point in autonomous AI threat activity.
stocks.summary_ko: 작가는 Google Threat Intelligence Group이 11월에 발표한 자율 AI 위협 활동의 중대한 전환점에 대한 조사 결과를 인용합니다.

stocks.summary_en: Author notes CrowdStrike confirmed AI agents were used against 200+ organizations and access at nine organizations in October.
